title: Fold coder-delegate branched runs onto task worktrees
body:
P4.1: coder-delegate keeps its own branched-run worktrees; move them onto the task worktree/slot machinery so lifecycle removal, slots and guard apply uniformly.

From the Paseo worktree gap analysis (docs/worktrees/2026-10-03-paseo-worktree-gap-analysis.md, 61580a0aec).
